settings.text: You have questions? We have answers.

settings.title: What makes OMEGA+++ different from other Omega products on the market?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ is a high quality, potent, and safe blend of omega-3 (EPA and DHA), 6, and 9 fatty acids. It is fortified with vitamin K2, CoQ10 Extended Release, borage oil, and Fertilized Avian Egg Extract for improved blood circulation benefits. OMEGA+++ is the only omega product on the market that contains our Proprietary Fertilized Avian Egg Extract, which contains egg bioactive growth factors to help stimulate stem cells.

settings.title: What is the Fertilized Avian Egg Extract?
settings.content: The fertilized avian egg extract comes from naturally fertilized eggs incubated for a very specific time and temperature, to extract bioactive growth factors at their peak activity. The eggs are non-GMO, and no chemicals or extreme heat are used in processing the fertilized avian egg extract to maintain the function and activity of growth factors. The fertilized avian egg extract contains biofactors such as FGF-2, which has been shown in studies to stimulate almost all types of cells including types of stem cells, to function to regenerate and stimulate repair in the body.

settings.title: What kind of fish does OMEGA+++ use?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ sources its fish oil from Engraulis Ringens, a member of the anchovy family. They are harvested in clean waters from the Humboldt Current off the coast of South America near Peru. Phytoplankton that the small fish consume in this region is rich in DHA and EPA, giving the fish the highest naturally occurring ratios of DHA and EPA of any other fish species. The fish oil also undergoes molecular distillation and is tested before and after the process to remove heavy metals and ensure the safety of the oil. The fish are sustainably harvested (Friends of the Sea member) and processed in a GMP and FDA compliant facility.

settings.title: I heard that omega-6 fatty acids are bad for you if you consume too much, is this true?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ contains only a very slight amount of omega-6 that is found naturally in the fish oil. It is only a few milligrams and will not add any significant consumption amount. OMEGA+++ contains a higher amount of omega-3 fatty acids, which offsets the very small amount of omega-6 in the supplement.

settings.title: Why should you take OMEGA+++ with LAMININE?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ and LAMININE are effective supplements on their own, but their effects are even more powerful when taken together. Our clinical study shows that OMEGA+++ can help regulate cholesterol, LDL, triglyceride and blood pressure levels, but the benefits are even more significant when OMEGA+++ and LAMININE are taken together.

settings.title: Does OMEGA+++ have a fishy aftertaste?
settings.content: Because our fish oil undergoes molecular distillation to remove any potential toxins and is then tested before and after the process, there is no fishy aftertaste or burps when taking OMEGA+++.

settings.title: What is the recommended dosage?
settings.content: We recommend taking one softgel one to two times daily with a meal. To obtain higher blood levels, 4-5 softgels can be taken daily, as recommended by some health experts.

settings.title: When is the best time to take OMEGA+++?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ can be taken anytime of the day with food and water.

settings.title: Is OMEGA+++ safe to consume?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ is safe for adults or children over 12 years to consume. There are no documented cases or instances of adverse reactions. Please do not take OMEGA+++ if you are allergic to eggs, fish, or soy. If you have any concerns, health conditions, or if you are taking blood thinner medication, please consult with your physician first before taking OMEGA+++.

settings.title: Is OMEGA+++ FDA approved?
settings.content: OMEGA+++ is manufactured in a facility that upholds current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) compliant. Only drugs or medical devices are registered with the FDA.

settings.title: Where can doctors read more information on OMEGA+++?
settings.content: Please click on the studies tab above to view our published study on OMEGA+++, or search for “Laminine omega” on PDR.net. Physician’s Desk Reference (PDR) is the most recognized drug information reference available in the U.S and trusted by healthcare providers.
